summary: Pre-market brief for the US open. The composite risk score eased 0.07 to 45.16, the risk level stays caution, the regime stays goldilocks and fact-layer confidence is 0.9163. Two speeds are visible. On the policy side the hawkish impulse hardened: the 10-year yield is 4.96 at the 99.92 percentile, the 2-year moved to 4.63 from 4.56, the 10-year real rate of 2.6 now sits at the 100.0 percentile, and with the effective funds rate at 3.63 against an implied policy rate of 4.1 a hike is priced while the overnight press put the odds above 92% and reported the long end at its highest since 2007. Asia traded the other way: the tracked A-share panel closed 7 of 11 higher (603986.SH +1.7457%, 688008.SH +1.7222%), the mirror image of the last completed US session, when semiconductor equipment -8.9763%, networking -6.8104%, AI infrastructure -6.4583%, semiconductors -5.6292% and data centers -5.5005% were sold against cybersecurity +5.9852%, enterprise software +5.0433% and AI software +4.1833%. Risk pricing still refuses to confirm the rate move: the VIX eased to 15.84 from 17.84, realized volatility is 8.8279, HY OAS tightened to 2.65 from 2.7 and IG OAS held at 0.8, while Nasdaq 100 futures cut losses to 0.3% from 0.7%. Pre-market conclusion: the binding constraint is the discount rate at a cycle extreme, not credit or volatility, and the near-term risk is a hawkish repricing into the FOMC while breadth (0.5419 above the 200-day average, new highs 0.0129 against new lows 0.0839) is already thin. Bitcoin at 76931, 1.3044% lower, and small caps at -4.2995 relative are the two least healthy parts of the tape.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The 10-year real rate of 2.6 is at the 100.0 percentile with a risk score of 100.0, the 10-year yield of 4.96 is at the 99.92 percentile with a risk score of 99.84, and the 2-year moved to 4.63 from 4.56, leaving the 10Y/2Y curve at 0.33. The macro block is the heaviest of the six at 63.8 and the only input at a cycle extreme.

The last completed US session de-rated AI hardware across the board: semiconductor equipment -8.9763%, networking -6.8104%, AI infrastructure -6.4583%, semiconductors -5.6292% and data centers -5.5005%, with Nvidia -3.3579%, Broadcom -4.7708%, Micron -5.253% and AMD -4.402%. Cybersecurity +5.9852%, enterprise software +5.0433% and AI software +4.1833% absorbed the flow, which makes this an internal rotation rather than an exit from the theme - but the semis relative line at -19.1577 keeps the leadership damage structural.

Breadth is thin and still thinning: only 0.5419 of names sit above the 200-day average, the new-highs ratio is 0.0129 against a new-lows ratio of 0.0839, small caps are -4.2995 relative and the equity structure block scores 52.73 while trending falling. A hawkish repricing into that base is the transmission channel to a deeper drawdown.

The liquidity buffer rotated out of the reverse repo facility: reverse repo fell to 1.42 from 5.255, into the 8.92 percentile with a risk score of 82.17, while reserve balances jumped to 2991310 from 2894531 and the Fed balance sheet edged up to 6740619 from 6737204. The buffer that absorbed the drain is nearly used up, so the liquidity cushion is thinner than the 32.96 block score suggests.

Hawkish policy into a hot wholesale print: the effective funds rate is 3.63 against an implied policy rate of 4.1 read as a hike, the overnight press reported that August producer prices accelerated to 5.4% year on year from 4.7% in July, and breakevens edged up (5Y5Y 2.34 from 2.32, 10Y 2.37 from 2.36) even as headline CPI sits at 3.35302 and core CPI at 2.44616. An inflation impulse into a hawkish meeting is the least friendly combination for a 4.96 10-year yield.

supporting_signals.claim: Volatility and credit both relaxed rather than deteriorated: the VIX eased to 15.84 from 17.84 (30.4 percentile) with realized volatility at 8.8279, HY OAS tightened to 2.65 from 2.7 in the 3.95 percentile and IG OAS held at 0.8.
No cross-asset stress signal: the confirmation metric is 0.625 and the dollar at 118.2126 sits in the 15.8 percentile, so the US rate move is not being transmitted as a global dollar squeeze.

Asia is constructive into the open: the tracked A-share panel closed 7 of 11 higher, led by 603986.SH +1.7457% and 688008.SH +1.7222%, and Nasdaq 100 futures cut their decline to 0.3% after being down 0.7%.
The trend block still supports risk: price is 6.4622% above the 200-day average, the 52-week drawdown is 2.1854% and 3-month momentum is 2.579.

contradicting_signals.claim: The composite only eased 0.07 to 45.16 with the risk level at caution, the regime at goldilocks and fact-layer confidence at 0.9163, so the index is not pricing the rate shock as a deterioration.

Software, security, platforms and advertising were all bid in the same session that hardware was sold: AI software +4.1833%, cybersecurity +5.9852%, enterprise software +5.0433%, cloud computing +2.7134%, digital advertising +2.3237% and fintech +1.6942%.

Wholesale price strength is not yet visible in consumer inflation and the labor market is not deteriorating: headline CPI is 3.35302, core CPI is 2.44616, payrolls are 162.0, unemployment is 4.1% and initial claims are 206000.

The unwind is concentrated, not broad: memory was nearly flat at -0.3066% and robotics at -0.3949% in the same session that had semiconductor equipment at -8.9763%, which is consistent with a de-rating of the most crowded AI hardware complex rather than a market-wide reduction in risk.

what_changed_today: Signal drift: the composite eased 0.07 to 45.16 while the 10-year real rate moved to 2.6 at the 100.0 percentile, so the rate shock is deepening while the headline index barely moves.
The liquidity buffer rotated out of the reverse repo facility: reverse repo fell to 1.42 from 5.255 (8.92 percentile, risk score 82.17) while reserve balances rose to 2991310 from 2894531.

Credit and volatility both improved over the same period: HY OAS tightened to 2.65 from 2.7 and the VIX fell to 15.84 from 17.84, which ends the pattern of volatility doing the confirming that the previous pre-market brief leaned on.

The CN close went the other way from the last US session: the tracked A-share panel closed 7 of 11 higher, with 603986.SH +1.7457%, 688008.SH +1.7222%, 300223.SZ +0.9975% and 600584.SH +0.799%, against 301308.SZ -0.7583% and 688525.SH -0.5311%.

The rates evidence was refreshed to an observation dated 2026-09-11: the 10-year is 4.96 and the 2-year 4.63, which finally aligns the fact layer with press reports of the long end at its highest since 2007.
watch_next: Advance Retail Sales on 2026-09-16 is the only high-importance print before the FOMC and the first test of whether the hawkish impulse is already hitting demand.
The FOMC meeting on 2026-09-28 with the implied policy rate at 4.1 against an effective rate of 3.63, and whether the 10-year holds 4.96 with the real rate pinned at 2.6.
FedEx earnings on 2026-09-17 with consensus at 4.21 per share as the demand read-through for the AI capital spending debate, and Costco on 2026-09-24.
The confirmation test still sits in credit and volatility: HY OAS at 2.65, IG OAS at 0.8 and the VIX at 15.84. The first genuine break in any of the three would confirm the rate move.

Whether the CN AI panel keeps decoupling from the US hardware de-rate, and whether energy adds a second inflation impulse - halted flows and a tighter oil-to-yields link are the channel. The fact layer carries no oil level, so that input stays qualitative.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the rate shock produced a rotation, not a de-risking event
points: The AI hardware sale did not become index-level stress: the VIX eased to 15.84 from 17.84 and realized volatility is 8.8279.
Credit is not confirming any stress: HY OAS tightened to 2.65 from 2.7 in the 3.95 percentile and IG OAS held at 0.8.

Asia is constructive and the trend block still supports risk: price is 6.4622% above the 200-day average with the 52-week drawdown at 2.1854%, the tracked A-share panel closed 7 of 11 higher and Nasdaq 100 futures cut losses to 0.3% from 0.7%.

base_case.title: Base case: caution persists - the constraint is the discount rate, not credit
points: The state does not change on a 0.07 move: composite 45.16, risk level caution, regime goldilocks, fact-layer confidence 0.9163, with volatility and liquidity easing rather than deteriorating.

Upside stays capped until the FOMC: the macro block is the heaviest at 63.8 with the real rate of 2.6 at the 100.0 percentile, while the semis relative line of -19.1577 keeps the leadership damage in place.

bear_case.title: Bear case: a hawkish meeting lands on a thin breadth base with the liquidity buffer nearly spent
points: There is no cushion in breadth: only 0.5419 of names are above the 200-day average, the new-highs ratio is 0.0129 against a new-lows ratio of 0.0839 and small caps are -4.2995 relative.
Rates leave no room for a hawkish surprise: the real rate is 2.6 at the 100.0 percentile, the 10-year 4.96 at the 99.92 percentile, the 2-year moved to 4.63 from 4.56 and the curve is 0.33.
The liquidity buffer is nearly used up: reverse repo is 1.42 in the 8.92 percentile with a risk score of 82.17 and reserve balances are 2991310, so further drain has to come out of risk assets.
